name: Clyde River Small Craft Harbour Completion
description: The Government of Canada completed construction of a new small craft harbour in Clyde River, Nunavut. The $38M project includes breakwaters, a fixed wharf, dredging, a launch ramp, and floating wharves accommodating 72 vessels. The harbour will be managed by the Niutaq Harbour Authority and is expected to be operational by open-water season 2026.

name: B2Gold Goose Mine Exploration — Bonanza Grades at Llama Deposit
description: B2Gold reported bonanza-grade drill results at the Llama deposit in the Back River Gold District, with hole 25GSE-702 cutting 13.7 metres grading 41.95 g/t gold and hole 25GSE-715Z1 intersecting 38.2 metres of 17.95 g/t gold. The company has budgeted $46M for 2026 exploration to extend mine life, with production expected at 170,000–230,000 oz gold in 2026.

name: Baffinland Mary River Steensby Rail and Port Expansion
description: Baffinland Iron Mines completed Inuit consultation for the Steensby Component of the Mary River project, clearing the final requirement to advance into construction. The expansion includes a railway and deepwater port at Steensby Inlet, increasing production from 4.2 to 22 million tonnes per annum. Construction estimated at ~$3B with 2,250 peak construction jobs.

description: Iqaluit is spending $43M in 2026 on water infrastructure upgrades, including the Astro Hill facility expected to continue into 2028. name: Arviat Modular Housing Factory
description: A 64,000 sq ft modular homes factory in Arviat, operated by Sakku Investments Corp. (Kivalliq Inuit Association), is nearing completion with an April 2026 opening. The facility will manufacture 40 homes per year. Cost increased from $50M to $70M due to post-pandemic inflation and need for additional warehouse space.

description: Prime Minister Carney announced over $253M for Nunavut under a new plan to defend, build, and transform the North.
